y-m-78-12.title: Kufanele sisethe kanjani i-mean ne-standard deviation ukuze amaphutha abe cishe ngu-5%?
y-m-78-12.topic: Ukuklama ukucaciswa usebenzisa isikhawu esingu-95% cishe se-normal distribution
y-m-78-12.goal: Usebenzisa impahla yokuthi cishe u-95% wehlela phakathi kwe-standard deviation engu-2 zizungeze i-mean, chaza izimo ze-mean ne-standard deviation yenqubo yokukhiqiza, bese ukhetha eyodwa phakathi kwezixazululo eziningana futhi usho ubungozi bayo.
y-m-78-12.material: Embonini yamasnack, cabanga ukuthi isisindo (g) sesikhwama esisodwa silandela i-normal distribution ene-mean μ ('mu') ne-standard deviation σ ('sigma'). Ukucaciswa kungu-95 g noma ngaphezulu no-107 g noma ngaphansi, futhi isikhwama esingaphandle kokucaciswa siyiphutha. Usebenzisa umthetho wokuthi cishe u-95% wezikhwama wehlela phakathi kwe-standard deviation engu-2 ye-mean (μ−2σ kuya ku-μ+2σ), sithatha ukuthi ukuze amaphutha abe cishe ngu-5% noma ngaphansi, lesi sikhawu kumele sibe ngaphakathi kokucaciswa.

y-m-78-04.topic: Ukumisa amakilasi nokuhumusha ithebula lokusatshalaliswa kokuvama
y-m-78-04.goal: Yazi ukuthi ukushintsha indawo yokuqala nobubanzi bamakilasi kungenza ithebula lokusatshalaliswa kokuvama libukeke lihlukile, thola iphutha emshweni ofunda ithebula, bese ubhala kabusha ukuze abafundi bangadukiswa.
y-m-78-04.material:
Ucwaningo lwarekhoda isikhathi sokulala esijwayelekile sansuku zonke (amahora) sabafundi abangu-30 besikole esisodwa (kurekhodwe ngezinyathelo ze-0.5 amahora). Idatha efanayo yakhonjiswa emathebuleni amathathu anamakilasi amiswe ngokuhlukile. Emathebuleni, 'okungenani ~ ngaphansi kuka-' kusho ukuthi inani lokuqala lifakiwe futhi elokugcina alifakiwe.

| Ikilasi (amahora) | 5~6 | 6~7 | 7~8 | 8~9 | 9~10 | 10~11 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inani labafundi | 3 | 7 | 13 | 5 | 1 | 1 |

| Ikilasi (amahora) | 5.5~6.5 | 6.5~7.5 | 7.5~8.5 | 8.5~9.5 | 9.5~10.5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inani labafundi | 7 | 12 | 8 | 2 | 1 |

**Ithebula C (liqala ku-4 amahora, ububanzi 2 amahora)**
| Ikilasi (amahora) | 4~6 | 6~8 | 8~10 | 10~12 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inani labafundi | 3 | 20 | 6 | 1 |
